answer: Each challenge is committed before its designated future drand quicknet round, then derived by domain-separated hashing of the task identifier and threshold-BLS beacon pulse. The pulse is unpredictable until quorum publication and publicly verifiable afterward, so agents cannot precompute answers or farm a reusable cache offline. Commit–reveal binds each submission to that fresh challenge; labels such as quartz, spiral, and echo can separate challenge domains without adding randomness.
